title: Medical Records Request (Release of Information) Intake Notes: Written Requests, Scope, Delivery and Withdrawal
content:
Notes for Riverbend Regional Health intake staff on accepting a Medical Records Request (Release of Information), the scope and formats that apply to it, and its withdrawal or change by the requester.

## The rule

A request is accepted through any of the product's request channels once it is in writing; when the requester does not limit it, the scope is the default record scope, and billing records are included (where the product includes billing records in the designated record set released). Electronic copies are produced in one of the product's electronic file formats; portal results are released without delay (the portal release period). Paper copies for pickup are held for the pickup holding period before being mailed. Only the requester can withdraw a request; prepaid fees are refunded when it is withdrawn before processing (where the product provides that refund). The requester may narrow the scope or change the delivery format at any time before fulfillment.

## Questions answered

**Must the request be in writing?**
Yes. A request is accepted through any of the listed channels once it is in writing.

**The requester did not say which records are wanted. What scope applies?**
The default record scope, with billing records included.

**Can a request be withdrawn by someone other than the requester?**
No. Only the requester can withdraw a request. A request may be withdrawn while it is received or while it is in process.

**A requester who prepaid withdraws the request before processing. What happens to the prepaid fees?**
They are refunded.

**Before the copy is delivered, the requester wants fewer records, or wants the copy mailed instead of downloaded. Is that possible?**
Yes. The requester may narrow the scope or change the delivery format at any time before fulfillment.

**How long is a paper copy for pickup held?**
For the pickup holding period, before being mailed.

## Withdrawal at a glance

| Status of the request | Who may withdraw | Prepaid fees |
|---|---|---|
| received, before processing | only the requester | refunded |
| in process | only the requester | — |
